== Missing data ==
* Star Wars CCG Palace installers (1997 Download Zone: DSWCCGPA.EXE, STS_SNDS.EXE, DEPALACE.EXE, background/animation/music/sound packs, .hqx Mac versions) were served from ftp.decipher.com/pub/decipher/ through a form. Wayback never captured them; archive.org search found nothing.
* DecipherCon 2000 SWCCG finals 80 kb stream (starwars-80.rm) was not captured; the 20 kb stream survives.
* No SWCCG screensaver, desktop theme, icon set, AIM buddy icon, deck builder or checklist program appears in the Wayback CDX of *.decipher.com (226,793 URLs).
* Several Wayback PDFs stop at exactly 1,048,345 bytes (sw2playergame.pdf, swccgglossary.pdf, deathstar2.pdf, bonrules.pdf); other capture dates not yet checked.
* Not yet read page by page: NewsFlash story pages, insidedecipher/archives article bodies, Creating Reality pages, DecipherCon 2002 pages, cgi-bin board pages (~64,000 URLs).

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Section date ranges come from first/last Wayback captures, not from Decipher announcements.

== Build notes ==
